facts.fact: The Herald reports that POTRAZ has licensed 880 data controllers under the Cyber and Data Protection Act enacted in 2021.
The Herald reports that POTRAZ, led by Director-General Dr Gift Machengete, is the body licensing data controllers under the Act.
